Phase4.50 important correction to Phase4.49: user bootin.elf SHA d2bc0c... has SECOND conditional boot path. It reads /setting/mode/dmode via open@0x948e, read@0x949a; byte 0/1/2/3 determines mode stage string (0xa5af 's ', 0xa4e6 's g r u ', 0xa4ef 's g r u l ', 0xa4fa 's g r u l i a '). 0x975a stores the selected stage ptr in config+0xc, 0x99c2..0x99c6 appends it into assembled im.elf command, and 0x9a54 calls system() once. Thus all s/g/r/u/l/i/a can occur as arguments of ONE im.elf process, potentially permitting same-process libObj RTLD_GLOBAL prior to appFw, provided loader/event gates actually execute. Earlier statement that stages i and a MUST be distinct processes only applies to the separate per-event system('im.elf i &') / system('im.elf a &') at 0x9b3a. Actual dmode file contents and runtime startup still unknown.
